event_summary: A fixed elevated city view shows dark and bright cloud masses changing across the sky while a gray veil remains over parts of the distant city.
raw_event_description: The video begins with an elevated view over rooftops, a checkered tall building, a large green park, a distant tower, and foreground antenna equipment under a dark cloud ceiling. Over time, the upper cloud shapes and brightness change, with darker cloud areas receding from parts of the top frame and brighter white cloud areas appearing, especially toward the upper right. A broad gray vertical-looking veil is visible over the left and central distance and varies in visibility while the buildings, park, tower, and foreground antennas remain in fixed positions in the frame.

reasons: The city, park, tower, foreground antennas, and cloud layer are visible from the start.
The ongoing sky and distant-veil changes are already present in the first frame.
